title: Consolidating Strategies for Countering Hate Speech Using Persuasive Dialogues
reasoning: The paper uses the 'Human Values' framework (based on the work of Rokeach and Schwartz) as a core component for controlling and evaluating the generation of counter-arguments to hate speech. It also specifically focuses on hate speech targeting religious groups such as Muslims and Jews and incorporates Aristotelian rhetorical strategies (logos, ethos, and pathos) into its persuasive dialogue model.
